resources.string: A browser gets a copy of your services\' keys, so CometOTP needs a lock (a PIN, a password or your screen lock) before it can pair one. Set a lock up in Security.

The browser gets an encrypted copy of your services, so it can show their codes even when this phone is not with you.

Every service is shared unless you turn Browser extension off in its details. HOTP and mOTP services always stay on this phone.

You can remove a browser later, and its copy is deleted the next time it checks. A computer that is lost or offline keeps what it already has.
Point your camera at the QR code in the CometOTP extension
That QR code is not from the CometOTP extension. Try another.
That code needs a newer version of CometOTP. Update the app, then try again.
That code pairs a browser. Use Pair a browser in Security → Connected extensions.

CometOTP reads the QR code here on your phone. No picture of it is saved. The code only lets this phone and the browser find each other through the relay: none of your services are shared until you tap Pair.
Setting up a private link through the relay…
Pair only if %s shows this same code. If it shows another, cancel: someone else may be trying to connect.
In %s, choose “My phone shows the same code”.
